Data.title: Industry By Industry Input-Output Table By Broad Sector, 2019
Data.footnote: This table shows flows of goods and services between industries of the economy. Each row shows how an industry's output is used for intermediate consumption by industries, and final demand whilst each column shows what an industry purchases to produce its output.
